name: Luxury Trap
description: Two finance experts guide economic irresponsible Danes, helping them with their economy.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Patrick lives in Hvidovre. In recent years, Patrick has isolated himself more and more in his apartment because he is embarrassed by his massive debt and by having lost his driving license due to speeding too often.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Jannika and Nicklas live in Karup with their little son, and they have difficulty getting the finances together. That's why they borrow from family - after spending their own money on fast food and tattoos.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In Stubbekøbing on Falster, Anders fights an unequal battle with his past. He has been a drug addict and although he has now been clean for many years, there is a huge debt with the old life.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sarah and Christian live for rent instead of in Christian's house. It is because the house triggers Christian's PTSD. The couple worries a lot, but doesn't act much. Can they change their habits?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In a previous relationship, Michael incurred debts for approx. 800,000 kroner, and although he has tried to get his finances under control, the money in the account disappears before the month is over.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Simon and Ninette have two children and a poor economy, yet they have taken out a loan so that Ninette can get the latest iPhone and used the children's gift money on consumption. The experts of The Luxury Trap must step in.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Karsten seems to have his life under control, but behind the facade things are sailing. His weakness for discounts has led to a sizeable debt. Can the experts find the cause of the weakness and help him manage it?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Tabita and Michael live together in Nykøbing Mors, but do not have joint finances, and the silence surrounding Tabita's debt of over DKK 500,000 threatens their future. Can the experts get the couple to talk?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Jonas is a nursery teacher and dreams about a career in music, but finances are tight, and he has now also borrowed money from his heavy metal band. The friend Jeppe wants to help, but doesn't know how. Do the experts?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Maria and Stefan are having a hard time. A year ago, Stefan suffered severe stress due to too much work. Now they face a dilemma, because Stefan can no longer work, but the economy is also stressing them.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: 32-year-old Stefan lives in Kastrup in a one-room flat. He works on a rescue ship sailing in the North Sea. When he sails, he spends almost no money. But when he comes home, it's a different matter.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: 42-year-old Jens lives in Tårs in North Jutland. He works as an agricultural assistant on a pig farm, and it is also his employer that he rents his house from. But Jens owes the rent.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In Rødovre, 25-year-old Malva lives with her little puppy, Lady. She is studying to become a financial economist, but has been through three different educations before, although without completing any of them.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: 24-year-old Oliver and his girlfriend Sarah have just moved apart. They cannot afford a deposit for a new apartment, so now they live with their respective parents.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Just outside Ribe, 38-year-old Lars lives in a rented house. He is behind on the rent and he has also missed the electricity bill a couple of times. If the finances are not brought under control soon, Lars will be put on the street.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Nicklas from Brønshøj is a mathematics teacher at a primary school. And then he has a towering payday loan debt. He has always looked askance at those who took out payday loans, but now he himself has ended up in the trap of debt.
